# Bundled libraries

These files are generated by `npm run build` from the pinned versions in `package.json`. Do not edit them by hand.

| File | Library | Version | Source | Updated |
|------|---------|---------|--------|---------|
| `tailwind.css` | Tailwind CSS (compiled from `src/tailwind.css`, scans `index.html`) | 4.3.3 | npm `@tailwindcss/cli` | 20-Oct-2026 |
| `chart.umd.min.js` | Chart.js | 4.5.1 | npm `chart.js` (same version jsdelivr served the live site) | 20-Oct-2026 |
| `chartjs-plugin-datalabels.min.js` | chartjs-plugin-datalabels | 2.2.0 | npm `chartjs-plugin-datalabels` | 20-Oct-2026 |
| `firebase.js` | Firebase JS SDK (app, auth, firestore), bundled with esbuild as `window.FirebaseSDK` | 10.8.0 | npm `firebase` | 20-Oct-2026 |

**After changing Tailwind classes in `index.html`, run `npm run build:css` and commit `vendor/tailwind.css`.** The *Vendor check* workflow fails the pull request if you forget.
